mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines for 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the mismatch signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and PAYEMS MoM > 0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the triggered instances.
